examples.summary: Green Bay Packers is the model’s pick at 64% for a game that does not finish tied. The largest supporting input is opponent-adjusted results. The strongest counterweight is defensive efficiency. These are patterns in past games, not proof that a statistic causes a win.

support.text: Opponent-adjusted results: Green Bay Packers 1550.79, Carolina Panthers 1398.19 (team strength rating from earlier results). The model weights this input toward Green Bay Packers.

Previous passer performance: Green Bay Packers 0.15, Carolina Panthers 0.04 (estimated points gained per passing play). The model weights this input toward Green Bay Packers. This is a prior observed passer, not a confirmed starter.
Recent defense: Green Bay Packers 22.00, Carolina Panthers 27.00 (average points allowed). The model weights this input toward Green Bay Packers.

risks.text: Defensive efficiency: Green Bay Packers -0.03, Carolina Panthers 0.04 (estimated points allowed per play). The model weights this input toward Carolina Panthers.
Recent scoring: Green Bay Packers 21.38, Carolina Panthers 25.50 (average points scored). The model weights this input toward Carolina Panthers.

examples.confidence: The model gives Carolina Panthers a 36% chance of winning a decisive game, so this is not a certainty. Refitting on resampled historical weeks puts Green Bay Packers's estimate between 62% and 68%. These ranges do not prove future accuracy; injuries and the upcoming starting lineup are not modeled.
